subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentence. There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Natural calamity has made i. are religious. b. River erosion has engulfed ii. for their security. c. Many farmers have migrated to towns iii. in search of living. d. Most of the farmers iv. the farmers solvent. e. The farmers use chemical fertilizers v. to grow more food. vi. the farmers poor. vii. many lands of many farmers.
guide_solution: (a + vi) : Natural calamity has made the farmers poor. (b + vii) : River erosion has engulfed many lands of many farmers. (c + iii) : Many farmers have migrated to towns in search of living. (d + i) : Most of the farmers are religious. (e + v) : The farmers use chemical fertilizers to grow more food.
